gen-gf-finlandica-fs-literata: Literata reads bookish and warm, with sturdy hairlines and slightly heavier curves that stay wide open. Literata's serif voice is the pair's best card, set against Finlandica, whose pen-like single-width line stays cool and tidy.
gen-gf-fjord-one-fs-bespoke-sans: Soft pencil, crisp finish. Fjord One carries a gentle thick-thin shift and curves left open at the ends, while Bespoke Sans below is sharper, with low contrast and generous gaps beside each stem.
gen-gf-frank-ruhl-libre-fs-bespoke-sans: Heavy strokes, hair-thin partners. Frank Ruhl Libre does its best work with that high-voltage swing from fat to fine, while Bespoke Sans does its best by staying low in contrast and leaving space around every curve.
gen-gf-fustat-fs-literata: Fustat draws every stroke at a constant thickness, whatever the direction. Literata, a text serif, adds a faint wedge of pen pressure in each curve, and that quiet texture is what makes the pairing feel alive.
gen-gf-gabriela-fs-bespoke-sans: Gabriela moves from heavy stems to lighter curves, like hand-drawn ink softening at the turn. Bespoke Sans does its best work in the opposite way, holding low contrast and leaving generous room where each curve meets its stem.
gen-gf-gantari-fs-literata: Professional in manner, Gantari has distinctly open mouths and a y tail as thick as its arm, which gives big short lines real presence. Literata, a classic serif, adds a slight charcoal-like pressure shadow that Gantari simply doesn't have.
gen-gf-gayathri-fs-literata: Gayathri brings a clean, contemporary sans-serif look, with open jaws on every curve and a modest dip in its thin strokes. Literata answers it with bookish, sophisticated sturdiness.
gen-gf-gelasio-fs-bespoke-sans: Bespoke Sans is the sharp, low-contrast sans-serif here, with generous room between curve ends and stems. Bespoke Sans looks best at a comfortable reading size, under Gelasio, whose light strokes recede only slightly.
gen-gf-gentium-book-plus-fs-bespoke-sans: Bespoke Sans is a sharp sans-serif with low contrast and generous space beside each stem, set beneath Gentium Book Plus and its moderate, sweeping curves. Gentium's visible stroke variation gives the page a classic voice.
gen-gf-geologica-fs-literata: Literata reads bookish, with the modest contrast of lightly engraved brass lettering. Geologica sits over it with every stroke at a fixed gauge, like a stencil brush, so the serif's subtle thick-thin shading stands out all the more.
